foofab — static site bundle (v3, mobile responsive)
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

WHAT'S NEW:
• Full mobile support (< 768px): hamburger nav, stacked layouts,
  bottom-sheet tweaks panel, proportional type scale
• Keeps existing default-image fallback (assets/images/<slot>.jpg)

DEPLOY: just drop this whole folder into your Vercel/Netlify/GitHub repo
(replace the old dist/ — but keep your assets/images/ folder with
your baked-in images).
